projection-operations.purpose: Own projection-operations operator workflow, UI contracts, and admin console language for Platform Operations.
projection-operations.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

release-controls.purpose: Own operator-facing release-lock and feature-rollout evaluation language plus kill-switch policy for cross-context platform capabilities.
release-controls.allowedWhen: Required when release automation or feature exposure is controlled by Platform Operations instead of a single business context.

release-dashboard.purpose: Own operator-facing release health, production currency, canary status, and release-dashboard language for Platform Operations.
release-dashboard.allowedWhen: Required when release-health artifacts and release-control policy need a single read-only operations surface.

insights-dashboards.purpose: Own cross-context analytical dashboard-read-model contracts, KPI projection behavior, and dashboard query language for Platform Operations reporting.
insights-dashboards.allowedWhen: Required when marketplace reporting needs read-only KPI projections without a transactional owner.

runtime-support.purpose: Provide reusable runtime-support assets shared by Platform Operations release-controls API composition.
runtime-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when policy runtime composition cannot stay inside one release-controls feature file.
runtime-support.justification: runtime-support centralizes event-store-backed Platform Operations services for API composition.
runtime-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when Platform Operations has no API-backed runtime services.

routes.purpose: Expose platform-operations route modules consumed by generated deployable adapters.
routes.allowedWhen: Required whenever Platform Operations contributes routes to a deployable.
